# BLAKE3 hashes of the contract WASM, checked by `scripts/check-contract-wasm.sh`
# (CI job `contract-wasm`). Format: <blake3-hex> <two spaces> <path>.
#
# A contract's on-network address is `BLAKE3(BLAKE3(wasm) || serialize(params))`,
# so these bytes ARE the address. Every line here is load-bearing; do not edit one
# to make CI green without reading what it means.
#
# There are two DIFFERENT facts recorded below, and the difference is the point.
#
# 1. The two `crates/freenet-git/contracts/*.wasm` lines are the checked-in
#    artifacts. `src/lib.rs` embeds them with `include_bytes!`, so they are what
#    the shipped binary PUTs and addresses. A change to one of these hashes is a
#    live re-key of every repo (repo-contract) or every pack (pack-contract) on
#    the network. Do not update such a line without following the migration
#    procedure in `legacy_contracts.toml`. (repo-contract's hash is additionally
#    pinned, in base58, by `tests/migration_guard.rs`, which enforces that
#    procedure; pack-contract has no migration path at all yet — issue #64 — so
#    for it this line is currently the only tripwire.)
#
# 2. The two `target/...` lines are what the contract SOURCES compile to today,
#    under the committed `Cargo.lock` and the pinned toolchain, built by
#    `scripts/build-contracts.sh`. Nothing ships these bytes. They are recorded
#    so that a change to a build input — a Dependabot bump to `Cargo.lock` above
#    all, but equally a `rust-toolchain.toml` bump or an edit to the contract
#    crates or their workspace-internal dependencies — turns into a red CI job on
#    the PR that introduces it, instead of lying dormant until the next person to
#    rebuild ships it. Updating one of these lines is not itself a re-key; it is
#    an acknowledgement that the re-key a future rebuild will carry just got
#    bigger.
#
# THE TWO SETS DO NOT AGREE TODAY, AND THAT IS A KNOWN, TRACKED DEFECT.
# The artifacts were last built on 2026-04-30 (b8edf90) and the sources have
# moved since, so `repo-contract.wasm` on the network does not contain the
# `get_state_delta` fix its source has carried since #62. That is issue #63,
# which also asks for exactly this gate. When #63 is resolved by rebuilding and
# committing the artifacts under the migration procedure, the artifact hash and
# the rebuild hash for each contract become equal, and the check below reports
# them as in sync.

# --- checked-in artifacts: these ARE the deployed contract addresses ---
a397cc99e79f99e2d320a24b0d4db5f6ab36d1f35e8454c87bf996e249ad9c13  crates/freenet-git/contracts/repo-contract.wasm
4140e677d7715f74805d958a47c52ec13b174dcda77ccfb6fa30204f257a0a87  crates/freenet-git/contracts/pack-contract.wasm

# --- what the sources compile to now: drift detector, ships nothing ---
303cd2a6f8e23adf680dc11d74a56b12a8248d4df57f30a4bc997c201beb43c4  target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/freenet_git_repo_contract.wasm
188cb7d49354f5b4ad89052ccc71d97e1484ce44821eb0b16f19031c3a1e9a89  target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/freenet_git_pack_contract.wasm
